texts: In tricuspid atresia a VSD is usually present: D.
With no connection from the right atrium to the right ventricle, all systemic venous blood crosses an atrial septal defect to the left heart, and the right ventricle fills only through the VSD.

The right atrium is large, the right ventricle is hypoplastic and lacks its inlet portion, and the ventriculoarterial connections are usually concordant; tricuspid atresia is one of the common single-ventricle lesions.
In the picture, water leaves the big blue lobby through the upper hole and reaches the small blue room through the hole in the lower wall.
Memory hook: a welded trident, a hole below.
